visual_description: A high-detail, 1:10 scale 3D print of a Triceratops horn core, mounted on a polished walnut base. The replica is a clean, bone-white resin, contrasting with the dark wood. A small brass plaque on the base reads: 'In appreciation of [Landowner Name] - Hell Creek Expedition.' It is shown being presented in a professional gift box with foam padding.

constraints.logic: A diplomatic tool used to build long-term 'prospecting' partnerships with private landowners.
constraints.background: A rustic wooden table next to the signed Consent Agreement.
